Bunk'd 4
programme.sub-title: Kto jest szefową? Lou jest szefową
programme.desc: Były doradca obozowy Lou Hockhauser (Miranda May) kupuje za dolara Kikiwakę od rodzeństwa Ross. Z początkiem lata kobieta przygotowuje się do nowych obowiązków dyrektora. Jednak zamiast organizować naprawę kanalizacji i zatrudnić kucharza, wolałaby pływać kajakiem po jeziorze lub spędzać wolny czas w Chatce Woodchuck. Podekscytowana czeka na ponowne przybycie obozowiczów, w tym jej kuzyna Finna (Will Buie Jr.) oraz Destiny (Mallory James Mahoney) i Matteo (Raphael Alejandro). programme.title: Lilo i Stitch 2: Mały feler Stitcha
Lilo \u0026 Stitch 2: Stitch Has a Glitch
programme.desc: Ulubieni bohaterowie Disneya powracają w pogodnej komedii o rodzinie, przyjaźni oraz ich sile, dzięki której możliwe jest pokonanie podziałów między różnymi światami. Stitch prowadzi na Hawajach rajskie życie. Pomaga także swojej przyjaciółce Lilo, która bardzo chce być podobna do swej zmarłej mamy. Dziewczynka przygotowuje się do udziału w wielkim konkursie tańca hula. Życie wydaje się beztroskie i idealne. Nagle okazuje się jednak, że Stitch ma drobny feler. Od tej chwili mała Lilo, Nani, Jumba i cała "Ohana" robią wszystko, by przywrócić ład i uratować swojego przyjaciela przed nim samym. W filmie usłyszymy trzy oryginalne piosenki Elvisa Presleya. W polskiej wersji językowej głosów postaciom użyczyli m.in. Jarosław Boberek, Julia Jędrzejewska, Jacek Braciak, Agnieszka Warchulska i Krzysztof Kowalewski.

programme.title: Dzwoneczek i uczynne wróżki
Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue
programme.desc: Elfy o przyrodniczych talentach przygotowują dla ludzi piękne, upalne lato. Niestety, wróżka Dzwoneczek zapuszcza się zbyt daleko do ludzkiej wioski, gdzie zauważa ją mała dziewczynka. Zostaje schwytana i uwięziona w małym słoiczku. Świadkiem tego wydarzenia jest ponura i egoistyczna elfka Widia, która wkrótce otrzymuje zadanie - wraz z Iskierką, Różyczką, Jelonką i Mgiełką - uwolnienia koleżanki. Zanim to się jednak stanie, Dzwoneczek zaprzyjaźnia się z samotną dziewczynką i postanawia pomoc jej rozwiązać rodzinny problem. Sprawa jest na tyle ważna, że wróżka decyduje się narazić własne bezpieczeństwo, aby doprowadzić do pomyślnego zakończenia. Piękna, ciepła animowana opowieść dla najmłodszych dzieci, będąca już trzecim pełnometrażowym filmem o losach znanej z "Piotrusia Pana" wróżki.

programme.title: Czarodzieje z Waverly Place: nowy rozdział 2
Wizards Beyond Waverly Place
programme.desc: Młoda czarodziejka Billie zostaje wysłana do świata śmiertelników. Trafia pod opiekę Justina Russo, który wiedzie zwyczajne życie z żoną i dwoma synami, na Staten Island. Zostaje on jej nauczycielem.

programme.title: Vampirina: nastoletnia wampirzyca
Vampirina: Teenage Vampire
programme.desc: 13-letnia Vee Hauntley (Kenzi Richardson) wyjeżdża z Transylwanii do szkoły z internatem dla artystów Wilson Hall. Ma nadzieję, że uda jej się spełnić muzyczne marzenia. Ukrywa swoją wampirzą tożsamość, by nie odstraszyć od siebie innych uczniów oraz by uniknąć łowców wampirów, Van Helsingów. Jej rodzice, Oxana (Kate Reinders) i Boris (Jeff Meacham), wysyłają razem z córką 600-letniego ducha Demi (Milo Maharlika), by opiekował się nastolatką. Vee zaprzyjaźnia się ze współlokatorką, Sophie Choi (Jiwon Lee), oraz z Elijahem Summersem (Shaun Dixon). Chłopak ukrywa przed innymi, że należy do Van Helsingów.

programme.title: Obóz Kikiwaka 4
Bunk'd 4
programme.desc: Były doradca obozowy Lou Hockhauser (Miranda May) kupuje za dolara Kikiwakę od rodzeństwa Ross. Z początkiem lata kobieta przygotowuje się do nowych obowiązków dyrektora. Jednak zamiast organizować naprawę kanalizacji i zatrudnić kucharza, wolałaby pływać kajakiem po jeziorze lub spędzać wolny czas w Chatce Woodchuck. Podekscytowana czeka na ponowne przybycie obozowiczów, w tym jej kuzyna Finna (Will Buie Jr.) oraz Destiny (Mallory James Mahoney) i Matteo (Raphael Alejandro). Młodzi ludzie chętnie powracają w znane sobie miejsce, a każdy z nich dowiaduje się o sobie czegoś nowego.

credits.actor: Lou Hockhauser, dyrektor obozu - Miranda May
Ava King, opiekun obozowiczów - Shelby Simmons

programme.title: Anuraag
programme.desc: A blind sculptor, Shivani (Moushmi Chatterjee) stays in an ashram and makes friends with a small boy (Satyajit), who is suffering from cancer.

programme.title: Balika Badhu
programme.desc: Arduous journey of child bride Rajni who is married before she is old enough to understand what marriage is all about, against the backdrop of Indian freedom struggle.

programme.title: Tere Payal Mere Geet
programme.desc: Premi, a bachelor poet, falls for a woman at Durga Devi's temple. Fatefully, he later finds her singing his poem at a dance hall.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Ajay Kumar, a successful and famous doctor, is on a quest to prove his innocence when he is accused of murdering his wife Swetha. He seeks the help of Ramya, a cop who secretly loves him.

programme.title: Naya Daur
programme.desc: A man brings turmoil to a peaceful village by disturbing the livelihood of the local farmers and workers. He does this by introducing new machinery in an attempt to make quicker profits.

programme.title: Namak
programme.desc: One day while playing with a loaded rifle, Prabhat accidentally shoots Gopal, and runs away, fearing that he will be arrested and sentenced to death.

programme.title: Doli Saja Ke Rakhna
programme.desc: This is a story of a young boy and a girl who fall in love with each other but decide to discontinue their relationship for the happiness of their respective families who are against their love.

programme.title: Vaastu Shastra
programme.desc: Jhilmil and Virag move to their new house with son Rohan and Jhilmil's younger sister Radhika. There is an old tree outside the house. The tree and the house are haunted by the dead.

programme.title: Raksha Bandhan
programme.desc: Madhav and Pravati saved Naagrani from the clutches of snake charmer and Naagrani blessed them with a baby girl.

programme.title: Amar Shakti
programme.desc: This film follows two brothers, heirs to the throne, who were separated because of the murder of their parents. One grows up and vows to avenge their death, while the other is oblivious.

programme.title: Bade Dilwala
programme.desc: A man upsets his wife by splitting a winning lottery ticket with a waitress.

programme.title: Safar
programme.desc: A pair of lovers are cruelly separated by destiny when the boy is diagnosed with terminal cancer. On his insistence, the girl settles down with another man, but he turns out to be a jealous husband.

programme.title: Jurm

programme.title: Conversation With Rajkummar Rao 2

programme.title: Mere Jeevan Saathi
programme.desc: A love triangle which involves a rock star, a woman he's always been in love with and his new sensual boss who will stop at nothing to get what she wants, no matter who she hurts in the process.

programme.title: Soch

programme.title: Kaun Jeeta Kaun Haara

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Goonj
programme.desc: Wedged in a political chaos, Sanjeev has to prove his innocence for a murder he did not commit and expose the real rogue, MLA Kalekar. But, the culprit is also the father of the girl he loves.

programme.title: Parinati
programme.desc: Ganesh, a potter living in a remote village of Rajasthan with his wife, Kurjan, and their son Laxman, is asked to make a choice for the sake of Laxman's bright future.

programme.title: Zubeidaa
programme.desc: Drama set in the 1950s, about an aspiring actress who marries a prince to become his second wife. Her rocky relationship with her husband and her decision to break free has fatal consequences.

programme.title: Star
programme.desc: Dev, an ambitious singer, wishes to become a star like Elvis Presley. But, his middle-class life compels him to give up on his dreams, until he finds a job with Charlie's Disco which changes his life.

programme.title: Haathon Ki Lakeeren
programme.desc: A dramatic story of the anguish & despair felt by a woman who is about to be separated from a child she adopted when the biological parents turn up on her doorstep demanding their child back.

programme.title: Pyaar Ka Safar
programme.desc: Bharath has lost everything since his childhood including his love. He is supported by his childhood friend Bhargava. Does Bhargava help him or will he end up destroying him completely.

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Ghar Mein Ram Gali Mein Shyam
programme.desc: Amar weds a village belle and they move to the city where she meets her neighbours Mr and Mrs Dharamchand. Soon, Amar begins to doubt her fidelity and Dharamchand devises a scheme to separate them.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.
